assets.purpose: Illustrative stamped query, cleaned candidate, separate variable genuine reference.
assets.final_prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Edit target: the attached three-panel signature workflow illustration. Preserve the polished white panoramic layout, burgundy DEMO stamp, navy arrows, invented signature style and realistic ink texture. Regenerate the illustration with the following scientifically important distinction.
LEFT panel and MIDDLE panel are the SAME QUERY before and after illustrative stamp cleaning: retain the same underlying query handwriting geometry in those two panels, with residual pale stamp traces in the middle. Cleaning is only an illustrative candidate.
RIGHT panel compares TWO DIFFERENT genuine signing instances from the same invented writer. The upper CLEAN REFERENCE must be visibly but subtly different from the query shown on the left and middle. Make its opening loop slightly narrower and more upright, vary the height and spacing of the small middle strokes, shift the baseline mildly and make the long final stroke and terminal flourish modestly shorter and at a slightly different angle. Preserve enough common personal style that the samples plausibly belong to the same writer. These must look like natural repeated handwriting, NOT exact pixel copies, NOT a completely different writer, and NOT just rotation or scale of the same signature.
The lower right sample is the cleaned query from the middle panel. The bracket compares that query with the independently written upper reference. Keep the variations clearly visible at publication size.
No authenticity verdict, no confidence number, no green check. Only readable text is DEMO inside the fictional stamp. No titles or captions within the image. Maintain the 3:1 wide composition and generous white margins.
The central lesson: a real verifier must tolerate natural within-writer variation; matching does not mean identical handwriting.

assets.purpose: Separate signing instances, qualitative regional influence, nonidentical zooms.
assets.final_prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Edit target: the first attached visibility-aware regional comparison figure. Supporting reference: the second attached revised three-panel workflow, whose upper-right clean reference and lower-right query show natural variation.
Preserve the crisp panoramic white layout, navy outlines, burgundy DEMO stamp, three corresponding regions, qualitative Higher weight / Lower weight / Higher weight labels, visible-detail inset, and Combined score output.
IMPORTANT CORRECTION: the top CLEAN REFERENCE and bottom STAMPED QUERY must be separate signing instances of the same fictional writer, NOT identical copies and NOT merely rescaled or rotated versions. Use the independently written upper-right reference in the supporting workflow as the top row: a narrower more upright first loop, slightly different middle-letter spacing and heights, a mildly different baseline, and a shorter final stroke with a subtly different angle and terminal bend. Keep the bottom query in the existing invented writer's style and retain its burgundy stamp. Their personal style should remain clearly related.
The right Visible detail inset must show the actual final segment from each respective row. The two enlarged final-stroke samples MUST reflect their small natural shape and angle differences; do not make those zooms identical. The comparison illustrates tolerance to genuine within-writer variation, not a perfect overlay.
Maintain geometric correspondence of the three regions despite the mild variations. Show qualitative influence only: no numerical weights or scores, no authenticity verdict and no approval ticks.
Use only these exact readable labels: Clean reference; Stamped query; Visible detail; Higher weight; Lower weight; Higher weight; Combined score; DEMO. Large labels, clear non-overlapping connectors, 3:1 landscape composition, high publication quality.
